prompt: A surreal pop-art commercial photography composition with an extreme scale contrast. A gigantic, beautiful young East Asian woman is comfortably resting her chin and hands on top of miniature rolling green hills covered in velvety moss. She is NOT looking at the camera. Her gaze is directed firmly DOWNWARD, looking lovingly at the miniature world below her, with a warm, affectionate smile on her face. Nestled between the green mossy hills directly below her gaze is a magical lake made of glowing, swirling marbled pink liquid. Floating on the pink lake is a tiny wooden sailboat carrying a small, cute white furry rabbit fairy. The background is a flawless, vibrant clear cyan-blue sky. Embedded in the foreground grass are the typography letters "Oiad" made of translucent 3D glass.
